exclusions.reason: The screen PLAY opens without a card (NO MEMORY CARD) keeps rendering, so whether a key pressed on it is pressed at all depends on render-drain timing. In natural-1 the PLAY step (back,left,ok,play) settled after 6.0M instructions retained and exhausted its 90M budget owned, leaving owned's next keys unpressed (prior-render-pending). In that PLAY step retained's 4 setter calls are a prefix of owned's 28, whose extras repeat the same 0x1c9/0x1c8/0x27f/0x280 block with result 1; the getter (lr, r0-r3, result) sets are equal (99 and 464 calls, no conflicting result, first ordered difference at call 26 is task interleaving); neither role makes a byte-changing settings write (1,357 and 9,499 same-value rows over the same 514 addresses).

Routes whose only effects are the 0x1c9/0x1c8/0x27f/0x280 block are left out, from crawl-4's edges or from a retained observation's re-based last steps. The block recurs in blocks of four on 1,120 of crawl-4's 4,528 reached edges; all of them exhausted their 90M budget in crawl-4, so whether their key is accepted depends on render-drain timing. In natural-1 run 3, crawl-trial-01462's OK was not consumed within 90M retained (32 block calls, as in crawl-4), while owned consumed it after 32.5M and opened SHOOTING MENU (1,5,2), setting 0x278 and 0x279 on both banks, as stock crawl-4 trial 1364 does from the same live view without the overlay; the getter (lr, r0-r3, result) sets agree with no conflicting result. On the current model, crawl-trial-01469 joins this class: in its last step the live view (16,472) never drains its render within 90M instructions after OK, so its dial-right is never pressed and the step shows only the block.

selection: reached crawl edges with a crawl-property-setter or crawl-property-commit effect, other than edges leaving the no-card playback screen and edges whose only effects are the 0x1c9/0x1c8/0x27f/0x280 block, one per ordered effect sequence (setter property ids and commits), the fewest presses from the attach root then the lowest trial; each route records the setter-entry r0 values and commits of its last step in the retained observation with receipt sha256 872646998d978a39892b2f6136f7f1a0132e5ffdba39e3857e8796a02c20aff9
